description: Source code for an Android shared audio decoder implementation within the starboard namespace, handling audio decoding, buffer processing, error reporting, and format management.

classes.name: AudioDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding audio streams, managing buffers, and interfacing with media codecs.

classes.name: DecodedAudio
classes.description: Class representing decoded audio data, including format and timestamp.

methods.name: AudioDecoder::AudioDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the audio decoder with stream info, DRM system, and flush behavior.

methods.name: AudioDecoder::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with output and error callbacks.

methods.name: AudioDecoder::Decode
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder and schedules processing.

methods.name: AudioDecoder::WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: AudioDecoder::Read
methods.description: Reads decoded audio data and provides timestamp and sample rate info.

methods.name: AudioDecoder::Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state, reinitializes if needed.

methods.name: AudioDecoder::InitializeCodec
methods.description: Creates and initializes the media decoder.

methods.name: AudioDecoder::ProcessOutputBuffer
methods.description: Processes output buffers from the media codec, handles format adjustments, and queues decoded audio.

methods.name: AudioDecoder::RefreshOutputFormat
methods.description: Updates output format parameters from the media codec.
